lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Ethiopia for 2022. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML format) representing food insecurity conditions during specified periods, with metadata including collection dates, scenarios, and classification scales.
